_comment: How each trail is drawn (docs/plan/SKINS-PLAN.md, 'Trails: how it works'). A trail is ribbons (Roblox Trails: strips along the path just flown) plus pieces (Roblox particles: small pictures dropped behind). `life`: seconds a bit of trail lives, so the stream is as long as one second of flight. `width`: studs across at the plane's tail. `fast_growth`: how much wider and brighter the trail gets, reached at `fast_at` times the build's own speed. `hangar_length`: studs of trail shown on the still plane in the hangar. Ribbon: `picture` (assets/fx/trails/<name>.png), `mode` (stretch: the picture spans the whole trail; static: stamped where the plane flew, one picture every `repeat` studs; wrap: repeats, riding with the plane), `width` (times the common width), `taper` and `fade` (start to end: width share, see-through share), `color` (tint), `glow` (0 paint, 1 light). Piece: `rate` (a second at the build's own speed; it rises with speed so the spacing stays even), `life` (seconds, least to most), `size` (studs, start to end), `fade`, `drift` (studs a second, any direction), `rise` (studs a second squared, up), `turn` (random angle at birth), `spin` (degrees a second, either way), `grid` and `frames` (a frame sheet: random cross-fades its frames at `fps`, once plays them through the piece's life), `colors` (one emitter each).
